name: Finku
long_description:
Finku is an AI powered personal finance app (budget & money manager) focused on geographies without Open Banking, such as Indonesia. 

Finku makes it easy for users to learn about their spending behaviors and recommends ways for user to achieve their goals faster (i.e saving more, etc.). Finku has helped 1 million Indonesian by offering a more seamless and innovative method of storing financial transactions, by processing these data-points & offering insightful suggestions for users, by providing access to a virtual financial assistant, hence creating a rewarding & sticky experience for our users.

Finku is backed by B Capital, Partech, Golden Gate Ventures, Goodwater Capital, Trihill Capital and YCombinator.
one_liner: AI powered personal finance app for Indonesia

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
At Finku our vision is to help people make better financial decisions regardless of their background!

Previously, I was a consultant at BCG where I helped detail out strategic roadmaps & incubate start-up concepts for large corporate together with BCG DV.

Growing up in Indonesia and having the privilege to study at Berkeley, I've grown to be passionate about financial inclusion, waste management, and sports. I'm always looking for ways to empower & provide hope to every individual.
